feed.title: Chemours to Pay $455 Million for Fayetteville Works Contamination
feed.summary: Chemours has agreed to pay $455 million over 15 years to North Carolina and 11 local entities to settle claims of PFAS contamination from its Fayetteville Works plant. This settlement is the largest environmental damage payment in North Carolina's history, with $75 million going to the state and $380 million to local governments. The agreement also includes a $135 million reserve fund from DuPont, Chemours' former parent company, to ensure payments in case Chemours faces bankruptcy.

feed.title: Evolution Petroleum declares $0.12 quarterly dividend
feed.summary: Evolution Petroleum Corporation (NYSE American: EPM) announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share for its fiscal 2027 first quarter. This dividend will be paid on September 30, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 21, 2026, marking the company's 52nd consecutive quarterly cash dividend. Evolution Petroleum is an independent energy company focused on onshore oil and natural gas properties in the United States.

The dividend is scheduled to be paid on October 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of October 2, 2026. feed.title: Should You Buy Elevance Health Stock For The Margin It Lost?
feed.summary: Elevance Health (ELV) has seen its net margin thin to 2.5% from a three-year average of 3.2%, primarily due to underperformance in its Medicaid segment. While the company has successfully restructured its Medicare Advantage business, it is now focusing on repairing Medicaid margins, including exiting unprofitable markets. Management's 2026 adjusted earnings-per-share guidance relies on Medicare Advantage and individual ACA, and the second half of 2026 will be crucial in determining if the Medicaid margin outlook is a prudent reflection or a sign of deeper issues.

feed.title: INVESTOR DEADLINE: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (REGN) Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead the Regeneron Class Action Lawsuit Before September 14, 2026 Deadline
feed.summary: Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro LLP has filed a securities class action lawsuit against Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: REGN) on behalf of investors who suffered substantial losses due to alleged misleading statements regarding a Phase 3 clinical trial for a melanoma therapy. The lawsuit claims Regeneron made false statements and failed to disclose critical information about the trial's flawed statistical assumptions and the unlikelihood of achieving its primary endpoint. The deadline for investors to lead the class action lawsuit is September 14, 2026.

feed.title: Hamilton Starbucks employees join the United Steelworkers union
feed.summary: Employees at a Starbucks location in downtown Hamilton, Ontario, have successfully unionized with the United Steelworkers (USW), becoming the latest Canadian Starbucks store to do so. The workers raised concerns including health and safety, unclear time and attendance policies, lack of seniority recognition, and the impact of corporate changes on wages and benefits. The USW will now help these employees elect a bargaining committee and negotiate their first collective agreement.

feed.title: HII wins $336M Navy contract for aircraft carrier materials By Investing.com
feed.summary: HII (NYSE:HII) has secured a $336 million contract from the U.S. Navy for the procurement of long-lead time materials for the upcoming aircraft carrier CVN 82. This undefinitized contract will specifically fund the advanced procurement of propulsion plant materials for the vessel's future construction at HII’s Newport News Shipbuilding division. The agreement highlights the initial phase of planning for the nuclear-powered aircraft carrier and supports thousands of suppliers within the industrial base.

feed.title: Deere and Caterpillar Are Both Up Over 40% This Year: Take Profits or Hold On for the Ride?
feed.summary: Deere (DE) and Caterpillar (CAT) stocks have surged by 47% and 44% year-to-date, respectively, significantly outperforming the broader industrial sector and the S&P 500. This narrow rally prompts investors to decide whether to take profits or hold their positions, as the gains are company-specific rather than a sector-wide re-rating. While taking profits addresses the concentration risk and less attractive reward-to-risk for new money, holding on is supported by the continued momentum and the fact that neither stock has shown a sell signal, attracting benchmark-driven investments.

feed.title: JPMorgan Cuts Price Target on Simon Property Group to $223 From $231, Maintains Neutral Rating

This adjustment comes amidst other recent analyst revisions for Simon Property Group, with some increasing and others decreasing their price targets, and varying ratings from Buy to Sector Perform. The article highlights Simon Property Group's recent activities, including launching an offering of senior notes and a commerce media platform.

feed.title: Amgen Highlights 26% Growth Drivers, IMDELLTRA Momentum and MariTide Potential
feed.summary: Amgen reported a 26% year-over-year growth in its six key commercial drivers, contributing to a 10% increase in total revenue, exceeding $10 billion. The company highlighted significant advancements for its oncology drug IMDELLTRA, including improved overall survival in a Phase III study for small cell lung cancer, and is seeking to reduce patient monitoring requirements to improve access. Amgen also detailed the promising potential of MariTide for obesity and related conditions, noting its differentiated dosing schedule, substantial weight loss in Phase II, and possible cardiovascular benefits, with Phase III studies underway for various indications.

feed.title: Elastic Launches Serverless Database for Faster Development of Vector Search Applications
feed.summary: Elastic has launched a new serverless database designed to accelerate the development of vector search applications. This offering was announced on September 11, 2026, and is expected to provide greater efficiency for developers utilizing vector search capabilities. The release follows recent positive analyst coverage and price target increases for Elastic, indicating market confidence in its technological advancements.

feed.title: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth Warns Depleting Supply Buffer Will Lead To Higher Oil Prices: Report
feed.summary: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth warned that oil prices are likely to remain elevated in the coming months due to the depletion of supply buffers that previously softened the impact of the U.S.-Iran conflict. He stated that the risks to oil prices remain on the upside, with Brent crude having already surged over 50% since the Middle East war began. Chevron plans to invest $7 billion in its Venezuelan operations, aiming to more than double production by 2031, funded by existing ventures in the country.

feed.title: $100 billion pipeline company Energy Transfer will move stock listing from New York to Dallas
feed.summary: Energy Transfer, a $100 billion pipeline company, is moving its primary stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange to the Dallas-based Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE). This move marks a significant win for TXSE, which aims to challenge the virtual duopoly of NYSE and Nasdaq and establish Texas as a global capital markets leader. The company expects to begin trading on TXSE on October 5, aligning its Texas roots with the new exchange's platform.

feed.title: EOG’s Mideast Bet Hinges on Rocks, Not Risks
feed.summary: EOG Resources CEO Ezra Yacob stated that geopolitical risks in the Middle East have not changed the company's assessment of its unconventional oil and gas prospects in the UAE and Bahrain. Yacob emphasized that the commercial viability of these projects depends more on the operating environment and subsurface derisking rather than regional geopolitical instability. This indicates a focus on geological and operational factors over political ones for their Mideast investments.

feed.title: Circle Internet Group CEO Jeremy Allaire Executes Class A Stock Sales Under 10b5-1 Plan
feed.summary: Jeremy Allaire, CEO of Circle Internet Group (NYSE:CRCL), sold Class A Common Stock on September 8, 2026, under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The sales occurred across five price tranches ranging from $96.50 to $100.34 per share, with some shares sold directly and others through irrevocable non-grantor trusts for his children. Allaire retains significant holdings of Class A and Class B Common Stock, with Class B shares convertible into Class A.

feed.title: Colgate Weighs Sale Of Mass-Market Personal Care Brands In $1 Billion Deal
feed.summary: Colgate-Palmolive is reportedly considering selling several mass-market personal care brands, including Softsoap, Irish Spring, and Speed Stick, in a deal estimated to be worth up to $1 billion. This potential divestment, for which Goldman Sachs is advising, aims to streamline Colgate's portfolio, allowing the company to concentrate on stronger brands amidst increasing costs and tariff pressures. The move aligns with a broader trend among consumer goods companies reassessing their assets to optimize capital and management focus.

feed.title: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth warns oil price buffers are depleted
feed.summary: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth warned that the buffers against rising oil prices have been depleted, making it more likely that crude prices will increase in the coming months. He noted that countries had released strategic crude stockpiles and the US had lifted restrictions on oil from sanctioned countries, but these measures are now exhausted. Wirth also discussed Chevron's operations near the conflict zone and its planned expansion in Venezuela, while the IEA reported a significant drop in global oil inventories.

feed.title: State regulators add in-person hearings in Dominion–NextEra merger
feed.summary: Virginia's State Corporation Commission has added three in-person public comment hearings for the proposed $67 billion merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy due to significant public interest. While one hearing is scheduled for November 5th in Richmond, the dates and locations for the other two are pending. Judge Samuel Towell noted that although in-person comments won't carry more weight than telephonic or written ones, these hearings are deemed appropriate given the case's broad impact across Dominion's service territory.

feed.title: Moody’s expects DigiPlus earnings to fall 20% this year before staging recovery through 2028 on expansion initiatives
feed.summary: Moody’s Ratings anticipates a 20% year-on-year decline in DigiPlus Interactive Corp's 2026 Adjusted EBITDA, followed by a recovery to previous levels by 2028. The ratings agency assigned DigiPlus a B1 corporate family rating with a stable outlook, citing the company's leadership in the Philippines' online gaming market and strong financial profile. This outlook is supported by low leverage, robust cash generation, and a net cash position.

This pullback is seen as a group rotation rather than broad tech weakness, especially as the Bitcoin mining ETF WGMI also fell while the broader Nasdaq 100 showed only minor weakness. Analysts remain positive on TeraWulf, with a recent Buy rating and a $19 target, and its substantial 20-year deal with Anthropic remains intact, suggesting the underlying investment thesis for these AI-infrastructure companies is still strong.

Despite some supply chain cost pressures, KLA remains confident in its ability to meet future demand and continues to invest in capacity and AI-driven operational efficiencies.

feed.title: Building the Future: Why Galaxy is Sponsoring a Solana DAT
feed.summary: Galaxy Digital is sponsoring a Solana Digital Asset Treasury (DAT), underscoring its belief in blockchain as the future foundation of global markets and specifically Solana's capacity for institutional-grade financial activity. This initiative involves a $1.65 billion private placement in Forward Industries Inc. to create the world's largest Solana digital asset treasury, aiming for active alpha generation through staking, lending, and advanced Solana-native strategies. The company highlights Solana's leading performance metrics, developer growth, and its unique position to accelerate institutional adoption with the backing of Galaxy, Jump Crypto, and Multicoin Capital.

feed.title: BurgerFi International declares Chapter 11 bankruptcy
feed.summary: BurgerFi International has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after experiencing significant sales and earnings losses. The company, which owns BurgerFi and Anthony’s Coal-Fired Pizza, has been struggling with deepening financial issues, reporting an $18.4 million net loss in the most recent quarter. A sale of the company is anticipated, with TREW Capital Management, which previously acquired Rubio's out of bankruptcy, having already bought BurgerFi's debt.

feed.title: Ero Copper (TSX:ERO) Sinks 8.49% as Copper Reversal Triggers Sharp Selling Pressure
feed.summary: Ero Copper (TSX:ERO) experienced an 8.49% drop in its stock price due to a sharp reversal in copper prices from record highs, triggering a broad selloff among Canadian copper miners. While the company benefits from improving operational performance and long-term copper demand, it faces near-term challenges from commodity volatility, inflation, and currency movements. Investors are advised to maintain a cautious stance given macroeconomic uncertainties and the stock's sensitivity to copper prices.

feed.title: Barclays conference: Chevron sees Venezuela as a factory development; Exxon says operators matter more than ever
feed.summary: At the Barclays 40th Annual Energy-Power Conference, Chevron discussed its $7-billion investment plan in Venezuela, aiming for a "factory-type" development to reach 600,000 b/d by 2031 from existing infrastructure. ExxonMobil highlighted its "once-in-a-lifetime" opportunity in Guyana, emphasizing that operator quality is increasingly important to resource owners. Both companies detailed their strategies for future upstream growth and resource development.

feed.title: Citigroup Issues Positive Forecast for Darden Restaurants (NYSE:DRI) Stock Price
feed.summary: Citigroup has raised its price target for Darden Restaurants (NYSE:DRI) from $245 to $248, maintaining a "buy" rating and suggesting an 18.51% upside. This positive forecast comes after Darden reported strong quarterly earnings, with EPS slightly above consensus and revenue up 13.7% year-over-year. The company has also issued optimistic fiscal 2027 EPS guidance, contributing to a "Moderate Buy" consensus among analysts with an average target of $230.79.

feed.title: Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA) Raises the Bar After A Strong Quarter
feed.summary: Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA) is gaining market attention due to strong quarterly execution, resilient beauty demand, and an improved fiscal outlook. The company's performance, marked by better-than-expected sales and earnings, is driven by comparable-store momentum, new store openings, international expansion, and a diverse merchandise mix. Ulta Beauty's strategy emphasizes a connected shopping experience through its physical stores and digital ecosystem, robust loyalty programs, and brand variety to navigate a competitive and evolving retail landscape.

feed.title: 3 paper packaging CEOs talk market volatility, pricing
feed.summary: CEOs from Packaging Corporation of America, International Paper, and Graphic Packaging International discussed the significant impact of economic and geopolitical disruptions on the paper and packaging industry, leading to market volatility and cost inflation. Companies are responding with price increases and cost-cutting measures, while also navigating challenges like fluctuating demand and agricultural sector issues. Despite these hurdles, they are focused on optimizing operations and building platforms for future growth.

feed.title: New Mexico restaurants face authenticity debate as small business AI adoption speeds up - Albuquerque Business First
feed.summary: A new study by JPMorgan Chase reveals a rapid increase in AI adoption among small businesses, particularly in the restaurant industry. While AI helps with tasks like forecasting and inventory management, there's a growing debate about the authenticity of AI-generated marketing content and its potential to alienate local customers. The article highlights both the benefits and potential drawbacks as small businesses in New Mexico integrate AI into their operations.

feed.title: NEE Stock Trades at a Premium Valuation: Buy, Hold or Stay Away?
feed.summary: NextEra Energy (NEE) currently trades at a premium valuation compared to its industry peers, driven by strong operational performance and growing demand for its services, particularly in Florida and renewable energy. While the company demonstrates consistent performance, positive earnings estimate revisions, and a solid return on equity, its high valuation suggests that new investors might want to wait for a more favorable entry point. The article outlines factors supporting NEE's growth, such as increasing electricity demand, renewable energy expansion, data center opportunities, and strategic partnerships, alongside its strong capital return program.

feed.title: AI fears have hit this data stock. Investor Sarat Sethi sees a buying opportunity
feed.summary: Investor Sarat Sethi views the recent sell-off in Verisk Analytics (VRSK) as a buying opportunity, despite market concerns about AI disruption and slowing growth. Sethi highlights Verisk's strong proprietary data advantage, recurring revenue, high profitability, and discounted valuation as key reasons for his bullish outlook. He believes the current slowdown is temporary and the company's unique position in the insurance industry makes it more resilient than perceived.

feed.title: Tungsten Automation Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Intelligent Document Processing
feed.summary: Tungsten Automation has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), marking its second consecutive year in this position. The company attributes this achievement to its ability to deliver production-ready AI for document processing at enterprise scale, coupled with agentic orchestration and governance. Tungsten Automation's flagship platform, TotalAgility™, processes over 10 billion documents annually for major organizations across various sectors, highlighting its significant impact and trusted solutions in document automation.

feed.title: Delta flight to Phoenix returns to JFK amid 'possible pressurization issue'
feed.summary: Delta Flight 791, en route from New York-JFK to Phoenix, returned to John F. Kennedy International Airport after a possible cabin pressurization issue. The Boeing 757-200, carrying 155 passengers and 6 crew members, landed safely, and passengers were later transferred to a new aircraft to continue their journey. Both the FAA and Delta confirmed the incident, stating standard procedures were followed.

feed.title: CWT Unit Gets Rate Hike Nod to Recover Infrastructure Investments
feed.summary: California Water Service Group's (CWT) unit, Washington Water, received approval for new water rates, expected to increase annual revenues by $4.1 million to recover costs from infrastructure investments totaling $26.5 million. This approval highlights CWT's ongoing focus on infrastructure spending and regulatory cost recovery, with the company investing significantly in utility plant and forecasting substantial capital expenditures for 2026. Rate hikes are crucial for utilities to fund capital-intensive operations, maintain and upgrade aging systems, and support reliable service and water quality improvements.

feed.title: Chemours, DuPont, Corteva reach $455 PFAS settlement with North Carolina
feed.summary: Chemours, DuPont, and Corteva have agreed to a $455 million settlement with North Carolina to resolve PFAS contamination claims from Chemours' Fayetteville Works facility. The settlement allocates $380 million to 10 counties and municipalities, and establishes a $135 million reserve fund from DuPont and Corteva in case Chemours faces bankruptcy. This agreement, which includes no admission of liability, also aims to mitigate future environmental impacts and ensure clean water supplies for affected residents.
